universe.signal_session_rule: CSV dates are the Brisbane date the scan RAN, not the signal session (recent night scans commit 02:00-05:40 BNE). Each git commit that wrote a recommended_orders file is a published version; valid_for = first ASX session opening after the commit; per session only the LAST version published before the open counts (earlier ones superseded); signal_session = the run's axjo_last_bar. Files with no git history (Feb-May, restored by backfill) use the file-date rule (those runs were ~21:00 BNE evening runs). Versions published mid-session are excluded (published_mid_session).
universe.order_levels: published levels tick-snapped (limit down, trigger up, stop down) before simulation

fill_model.MARKET_OPEN: fill at valid_for official open + slippage
fill_model.LIMIT: first bar with low <= limit; fill = min(bar open, limit); no slippage; no touch = unfilled
fill_model.STOP: first bar with high >= trigger; fill = max(bar open, trigger) + slippage
fill_model.STOP_LIMIT: first bar with high >= trigger; bar open > limit = unfilled (gapped_past_limit); else fill = max(open, trigger) + slippage, capped at limit
fill_model.open_validation_variant: skip when the valid_for open is at/below the initial stop (see policies[].variants.open_validation)
fill_model.fill_bar: conservative: fill-bar low at/below the stop = stopped out; fill-bar high never sets the peak (only its close)
exit_bar_rules: open <= stop level -> exit at open (gap-through)
low <= stop level -> exit at stop level
raise peak with high; trail = f(peak), never lowered
close <= new stop level -> exit at the new level (continuity)
time stop: official close of the Nth session after the fill session
fill_model.intrabar_assumption: low before high (conservative); high-first bracket in variants
fill_model.r_definition: R = P&L / (shares x planned risk_per_share), planned = entry_ref - stop

price_basis: UNADJUSTED (as-traded, split-adjusted) OHLC for the system; dividends received while holding are ignored. Benchmark uses ADJUSTED close (dividends reinvested) -- this asymmetry favours the benchmark slightly.

costs.applied: both sides; net stats include both, gross stats exclude both

policies.label: Legacy: exit at close of day 5

policy_selection.rule: Candidate = best mean NET R per trade on the first half of history (valid_for < split_date, >= 20 trades). Switch from the incumbent (fixed_5d) only if the candidate's paired per-signal advantage in net R has t >= 2.0 in the first half; else keep the incumbent. Second half = out-of-sample, reported for all policies.
policy_selection.reason: first-half best was trail_2atr but its paired edge over fixed_5d had t=0.71 < 2.0 -- not evidence, keep incumbent

trail_1pct.question: Hold with a 1% trailing stop from the peak (20-session time stop) instead of selling at day 5?

portfolio.cash_yield_note: the main equity curve earns 0% on idle cash; total_return_with_cash_yield credits idle cash with AAA.AX's daily adjusted return
portfolio.rules: each valid_for day the first 2 published orders (rank order) get a slot; unfilled orders use their slot; size = floor(equity_prev_close x 1% / planned risk), capped at 25% of equity and start-of-day cash; same symbol already held = skipped; A$10 brokerage per side; open positions marked to the daily close

setups_sample.note: watchlist_full rows whose raw strategy trigger fired (signal_raw), INCLUDING ones that failed a gate or lost on rank -- a larger per-strategy sample, NOT the track record. Overlaps the recommended orders.

reconciliation.legacy_published_reference: v1 track-record (2026-11-21): n=177 trades with 5D R, mean R -0.170, while its equity_curve_proxy showed +137% -- that curve compounded each day's AVERAGE 5-day return as if it were a 1-day return (5x overlap counting), so it was not a P&L.

steps.what: v1 code on today's data: file-date timing, dedup on (signal_date, symbol, strategy), weekend re-runs counted again, text STOP_LIMIT entries dropped, orders assumed filled at the published level even if never traded, MR bought at the open, adjusted bars, every stop = exactly -1R, no costs
same v1 R formula, but each order on the session it was really published for

as B on UNADJUSTED bars: v1 compared as-traded published stops with dividend-ADJUSTED bars (scaled down after every later dividend), which tripped stops that were never hit and silently dropped trades whose adjusted open sat below the as-traded stop
real fill rules (unfilled orders are not trades), unadjusted bars, gap-through stops, daily bars (low assumed before high), no costs
as C on reconciled hourly bars
as D plus A$10 brokerage per side and 1 tick slippage per side

verdict: Over 06 Feb 2026-24 Nov 2026 the system (exit policy fixed_5d, net of costs) returned +7.0% vs the ASX200 ETF STW.AX +3.5% (dividends included): OUTPERFORMING by 3.5 pp. Per trade: 138 closed trades, mean +0.08R net, win rate 39%. 5 of 7 exit policies beat the ETF (best: trail_2atr +14.5%). Cash (AAA.AX) returned +3.6%; mean-R 95% CI [-0.14, +0.29] includes zero -> no demonstrated edge.
